Render a scene

Source: R/render.R
render.Rd

Renders a scene to a video or image file, like manim render does.

Usage

render(
  scene,
  quality = NULL,
  format = NULL,
  output_file = NULL,
  save_last_frame = NULL,
  preview = NULL,
  transparent = NULL,
  module_name = NULL,
  scene_name = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

scene

A Scene subclass (R6 generator), a scene instance, or a function of one argument self used as construct(). A scene instance keeps the camera it was created with, so quality and other camera settings only apply when scene is a class or a function.

quality

One of "l", "m", "h", "p", "k" or a preset name of QUALITIES. Defaults to the current manim_config() quality.

format

The artifact to write: "auto" (the default: MP4, or MOV when transparent; a scene without animations is saved as its last frame), "mp4", "mov", "webm", "gif", "png" (only the last frame), "png-sequence" (every frame) or "none".

output_file

Name of the artifact. A relative name is placed in the video directory (or the images directory for PNG output), as upstream's -o; an absolute path is used as it is. Defaults to the scene name in <media_dir>/videos/<module>/<quality>/ (videos) or <media_dir>/images/<module>/ (images). The media folder is in the session's temporary directory unless media_dir is set, for example manim_config(media_dir = "media") to keep the output in the working directory.

save_last_frame

TRUE is short for format = "png".

preview

Open the result when done (the RStudio Viewer when available). Defaults to the preview setting.

transparent

Render with a transparent background.

module_name

Folder name under <media_dir>/videos/ and <media_dir>/images/; render_file() uses the script name. Defaults to "manimR".

scene_name

Name used for output files; defaults to the scene class name.

...

Further manim_config() settings for this render, such as background_color, frame_rate, save_sections or dry_run.

Value

The path of the artifact, invisibly, with class manim_output; NULL when nothing is written (format = "none" or dry_run).

Examples

# The last frame as a PNG file in the session's temporary directory.
render(function(self) self$play(Create(Circle())), quality = "l", format = "png",
       media_dir = tempdir())
#> INFO File ready at '/tmp/Rtmp2fvc9m/images/manimR/Scene_manimR_v0.1.0.png'
#> INFO Rendered Scene
#> Played 1 animations
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# A video in the media folder (by default in the session's temporary
# directory); this needs ffmpeg.
render(function(self) self$play(Create(Circle())), quality = "l")
} # }
